checks: source_shape: requires a complete TopModule ending in endmodule, and rejects include directives and file IO

undefined_submodules: text check that flags an instantiation whose module is never defined in the same file, because analysis does not resolve instantiation and the failure would otherwise appear only at elaboration
xvlog_compile: the only tool that runs the compiler
deterministic_repairs: repair_ansi_declarations: turns an ANSI output assigned in a procedural block into output reg and drops the duplicate body declaration, accepted only if the source then recompiles
agent.no_functional_feedback: The agent never sees the reference testbench, expected outputs or simulation results. Only compiler diagnostics and the two text checks above.

prompt_probe.qualification: Six AMD CPU tests of explicit inputs, preserved classification and stage commands, request isolation, malformed summaries, environment errors, input mutation and propagated deadline exceptions. Stage outputs simulated; no EDA/model/FIFO.

contract.health: GET /v1/health returns ready/track/model/vram_gb; verified end to end over HTTP, including the 401 without a token
contract.solve: POST /v1/solve takes task_id, nonce, mode, prompt, interface and deadline_s, and returns exactly task_id, solution, trace and elapsed_s; verified with eight conformance cases, including an empty interface, a one-second deadline returning an empty solution rather than an error, and 400 for a missing task_id
contract.sigterm: exits within 0.10 s of SIGTERM, measured both early and while EDA tools were running, against the contract's ten-second limit
